title: Native adic modules, slice Hom and evaluation
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $K=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ (Lean `PadicAlgCl ℓ`), and $Y$ any scheme. Use a small representative of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $R_Y$ be the sheaf of commutative $K$-algebras whose sections on $U$ are continuous functions $|U|\to K$ whose values locally span a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q_\ell$-subspace, with pointwise operations and restriction by precomposition. Let $\mathcal A_Y$ be the native category of internal $R_Y$-modules in sheaves of $K$-vector spaces: an object is a sheaf $M$ with an associative unital action $R_Y\otimes_K M\to M$, where $\otimes_K$ is sheafified sectionwise tensor; a morphism commutes with this action. Let $\operatorname{Mod}(R_Y)$ denote the sectionwise module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The native tensor $M\otimes_{R_Y}N$ is the coequalizer imposing equality of the two $R_Y$-actions, and $[M,N]_{\mathcal A_Y}$ is its right internal Hom (the right adjoint to tensor with $M$).

There is an equivalence $E_Y:\mathcal A_Y\simeq\operatorname{Mod}(R_Y)$ leaving underlying sheaves, sections and morphisms unchanged and sending the action to its sectionwise action. It carries the regular module to $R_Y$ and the native relative tensor to the sheaf tensor representing $R_Y$-balanced bilinear maps. It has natural isomorphisms
$$E_Y([M,N]_{\mathcal A_Y})\cong\mathcal Hom_{R_Y}(E_YM,E_YN),$$
where the right side is the slice-Hom sheaf [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Under these isomorphisms native evaluation is the slice map $(x,\lambda)\mapsto\lambda(x)$, and native bidual evaluation into the regular module is $x\mapsto(\lambda\mapsto\lambda(x))$.

For every site object $j:U\to Y$, identify $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}/U$. Then $R_U=R_Y|_U$ through the identity on functions on each further object $V\to U$. The native adic module pullback $j^*:\mathcal A_Y\to\mathcal A_U$ is the inverse image $j^{-1}$ of the underlying sheaf of $K$-vector spaces along the morphism of small pro-etale sites induced by $j$, made a $j^{-1}R_Y$-module through the monoidal structure of $j^{-1}$, followed by extension of scalars $R_U\otimes_{j^{-1}R_Y}(-)$ along the map $j^{-1}R_Y\to R_U$ given by pullback of functions. Under $E_Y,E_U$ and the identification above, $j^{-1}R_Y\to R_U$ is the identity and $j^*$ corresponds to literal restriction to this slice, and the displayed tensor, internal-Hom and evaluation comparisons commute with this restriction. In particular native local finite-free trivializations correspond exactly to slice trivializations over $R_Y|_U$.

proof.text: Construct the normalized comparison at each base from the explicit section-module equivalence and its unit and coordinate maps, with the fixed-functor tensor/Hom comparison.
Apply restriction compatibility to this family of base comparisons. The native coefficient identity follows by evaluating the actual coefficient localization theorem on each section.

The equivalence functor is fully faithful, so its map on isomorphisms is a bijection. Conjugate by the inverse of the slice comparison and by the fixed free-module comparison. Composition gives the stated trivialization bijection, its inverse, and the required formula on homomorphisms, including rank zero.
